testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.data.local.SecureKeyStoreProviderScopeTest

testcase.name: clearing the legacy provider also removes a pre-migration pair
writing a second provider does NOT destroy the first
writing the same provider twice replaces only that provider
an absent provider reads empty rather than another provider's key
migration does not overwrite a key already scoped to the provider
the legacy single-slot layout migrates onto the default provider
two providers can hold keys at the same time
providersWithKeys lists exactly the stored providers
clearing one provider leaves the others alone
a blank key is not stored as a credential
